sbe:messageSchema.description: GCM-MD normalized internal market data messages

composite.name: PRICENULL9
composite.description: Optional price: int64 mantissa, constant exponent -9. Null = field not present (delta).

composite.name: PRICE9
composite.description: Required price: int64 mantissa, constant exponent -9

type.name: QtyNULL
type.description: Optional quantity. Null = not present in delta.

type.name: Symbol
type.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol (e.g. NGQ2026). Year expanded to 4 digits.

type.name: SourceSymbol
type.description: Exact symbol as received from source (e.g. CME sends NGQ6). Verbatim, no transformation.

composite.name: MaturityMonthYear
composite.description: Contract maturity: year, month, optional day/week

enum.name: UpdateType
enum.description: Identifies whether this message is a full snapshot or an incremental delta update

validValue.name: SNAPSHOT
validValue.description: Full instrument state — all fields populated

validValue.name: DELTA
validValue.description: Incremental update — only changed fields populated, others null

enum.name: AssetClass
enum.description: Broad asset class for NATS subject routing

enum.name: TradingStatus
enum.description: Current trading state of the instrument

set.name: FieldPresence
set.description: Bitmask indicating which optional fields are present in this message

choice.name: bidNumOrders
choice.description: Bid number of orders is present

choice.name: askNumOrders
choice.description: Ask number of orders is present

sbe:message.name: MarketDataTick
sbe:message.description: Normalized market data tick — snapshot or delta for a single instrument

field.name: sequenceId
field.description: Globally monotonic sequence ID assigned by GCM-MD sequencer

field.name: sourceTimestamp
field.description: Source-originated timestamp (nanos since Unix epoch). Maps from CME TransactTime.

field.name: ingestTimestamp
field.description: Line handler ingest timestamp (nanos since Unix epoch)

field.name: sequenceTimestamp
field.description: Sequencer assignment timestamp (nanos since Unix epoch)

field.name: updateType
field.description: SNAPSHOT (full state) or DELTA (only changed fields)

field.name: assetClass
field.description: Broad asset class for routing

field.name: instrumentType
field.description: Future, option, spread, or spot

field.name: fieldPresence
field.description: Bitmask indicating which optional fields carry data in this message

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source-specific per-instrument sequence number (e.g. CME RptSeq)

field.name: symbol
field.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol. CME: derived from tag 55 with year expanded (NGQ6 → NGQ2026).

field.name: sourceSymbol
field.description: Exact symbol as received from data source. CME: tag 55 Symbol verbatim (e.g. NGQ6).

field.name: source
field.description: Data source (CME, ICE, BBG, etc.)

field.name: exchange
field.description: Exchange code (NYMX, XCME, etc.). CME: tag 207.

field.name: sourceSecurityId
field.description: Source-native instrument ID. CME: tag 48 SecurityID.

field.name: asset
field.description: Product code. CME: tag 6937 Asset.

field.name: securityGroup
field.description: Security group. CME: tag 1151 SecurityGroup.

field.name: currency
field.description: Price currency (USD, EUR, etc.). CME: tag 15.

field.name: maturityMonthYear
field.description: Contract maturity. CME: tag 200.

field.name: bidPrice
field.description: Best bid price. CME: MDEntryType 0 (Bid).

field.name: askPrice
field.description: Best ask/offer price. CME: MDEntryType 1 (Offer).

field.name: lastTradePrice
field.description: Last trade price. CME: MDEntryType 2 (Trade) from MDIncrementalRefreshTradeSummary.

field.name: settlementPrice
field.description: Settlement price. CME: MDEntryType 6 (SettlementPrice) from MDIncrementalRefreshDailyStatistics.

field.name: openPrice
field.description: Session opening price. CME: MDEntryType 4 (OpenPrice) from MDIncrementalRefreshSessionStatistics.

field.name: highPrice
field.description: Session high trade price. CME: MDEntryType 7 (TradingSessionHighPrice).

field.name: lowPrice
field.description: Session low trade price. CME: MDEntryType 8 (TradingSessionLowPrice).

field.name: impliedBidPrice
field.description: Implied bid price. CME: MDEntryType E (ImpliedBid).

field.name: impliedAskPrice
field.description: Implied ask/offer price. CME: MDEntryType F (ImpliedOffer).

field.name: vwapPrice
field.description: Session VWAP. CME: MDEntryType 9 (VWAP) from SessionStatistics (sinceVersion 10).

field.name: bidSize
field.description: Aggregate size at best bid. CME: MDEntrySize where MDEntryType=Bid.

field.name: askSize
field.description: Aggregate size at best ask. CME: MDEntrySize where MDEntryType=Offer.

field.name: lastTradeQty
field.description: Last trade quantity. CME: MDEntrySize from MDIncrementalRefreshTradeSummary.

field.name: totalVolume
field.description: Total cleared volume for the session. CME: MDEntryType B (ClearedVolume).

field.name: electronicVolume
field.description: Cumulative electronic traded volume. CME: MDEntryType e (ElectronicVolume).

field.name: openInterest
field.description: Open interest. CME: MDEntryType C (OpenInterest).

field.name: bidNumOrders
field.description: Aggregate number of orders at best bid. CME: NumberOfOrders from Book (Bid).

field.name: askNumOrders
field.description: Aggregate number of orders at best ask. CME: NumberOfOrders from Book (Offer).

field.name: highLimitPrice
field.description: Upper price limit for the trading day. CME: tag 1149 HighLimitPrice.

field.name: lowLimitPrice
field.description: Lower price limit for the trading day. CME: tag 1148 LowLimitPrice.

field.name: maxPriceVariation
field.description: Differential value for price banding. CME: tag 1143 MaxPriceVariation.

field.name: tradingStatus
field.description: Current trading state. CME: mapped from SecurityTradingStatus.

field.name: settlementType
field.description: Settlement price type. CME: mapped from SettlPriceType bitfield.

field.name: minPriceIncrement
field.description: Minimum price increment (tick size). CME: tag 969 MinPriceIncrement.

field.name: displayFactor
field.description: Multiplier to convert price to conventional display. CME: tag 9787 DisplayFactor.

field.name: unitOfMeasure
field.description: Unit of measure for contract size. CME: tag 996 (e.g. MMBtu for NG).

field.name: contractSize
field.description: Contract size in UoM units. CME: tag 1147 UnitOfMeasureQty.

field.name: expiryDate
field.description: Last trading date as YYYYMMDD. Derived from CME EventType=LastEligibleTradeDate.

field.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol (e.g. NGQ2026)

field.name: source
field.description: Data source (CME)

field.name: exchange
field.description: Exchange (NYMX)

field.name: sourceSecurityId
field.description: Source-native security ID

field.name: asset
field.description: Product code (NG)

field.name: securityGroup
field.description: Security group

field.name: currency
field.description: Price currency

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: Settlement currency. CME: tag 120.

field.name: maturityMonthYear
field.description: Contract maturity

field.name: assetClass
field.description: Asset class

field.name: instrumentType
field.description: Instrument type (future, option, etc.)

field.name: minPriceIncrement
field.description: Minimum price tick. CME: tag 969.

field.name: displayFactor
field.description: Price display conversion factor. CME: tag 9787.

field.name: unitOfMeasure
field.description: Contract unit of measure (MMBtu, bushels, etc.). CME: tag 996.

field.name: contractSize
field.description: Contract size in UoM. CME: tag 1147.

field.name: minTradeVol
field.description: Minimum trading volume. CME: tag 562.

field.name: maxTradeVol
field.description: Maximum trading volume. CME: tag 1140.

field.name: originalContractSize
field.description: Fixed contract value. CME: tag 5849.

field.name: tradingRefPrice
field.description: Reference/settlement price from prior session. CME: tag 1150.

field.name: highLimitPrice
field.description: High limit price. CME: tag 1149.

field.name: lowLimitPrice
field.description: Low limit price. CME: tag 1148.

field.name: maxPriceVariation
field.description: Max price variation. CME: tag 1143.

field.name: priorSettlePrice
field.description: Prior session settlement. CME: tag 1150 TradingReferencePrice.

field.name: priorVolume
field.description: Prior session cleared volume. CME: tag 5791.

field.name: priorOpenInterest
field.description: Prior session open interest. CME: tag 5792.

field.name: activationTime
field.description: Instrument activation time (nanos epoch). CME: EventType=Activation.

field.name: expirationTime
field.description: Instrument expiration time (nanos epoch). CME: EventType=LastEligibleTradeDate.

field.name: tradingStatus
field.description: Trading status at definition time

sbe:message.name: TradeSummary
sbe:message.description: Trade execution detail for a single instrument

field.name: sequenceId
field.description: Global sequence ID

field.name: sourceTimestamp
field.description: Source timestamp (nanos since epoch). CME: TransactTime.

field.name: ingestTimestamp
field.description: Ingest timestamp

field.name: symbol
field.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol

field.name: sourceSymbol
field.description: Exact symbol as received from data source. CME: tag 55 verbatim.

field.name: source
field.description: Data source

field.name: sourceSecurityId
field.description: Source security ID

field.name: assetClass
field.description: Asset class

field.name: tradePrice
field.description: Trade price. CME: MDEntryPx from TradeSummary.

field.name: tradeQty
field.description: Consolidated trade quantity. CME: MDEntrySize from TradeSummary.

field.name: numberOfOrders
field.description: Number of orders participating in the match. CME: NumberOfOrders.

field.name: aggressorSide
field.description: Aggressor side: 0=NoAggressor, 1=Buy, 2=Sell. CME: AggressorSide.

field.name: sourceTradeId
field.description: Source-specific trade ID. CME: MDTradeEntryID.

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument seq num. CME: RptSeq.

sbe:message.name: Heartbeat
sbe:message.description: Line handler heartbeat — periodic liveness signal

field.name: sequenceId
field.description: Global sequence ID

field.name: timestamp
field.description: Heartbeat timestamp (nanos since epoch)

field.name: source
field.description: Source identifier

field.name: instrumentCount
field.description: Number of active instruments on this feed

field.name: messageCount
field.description: Cumulative message count since line handler start

sbe:message.name: BookUpdate
sbe:message.description: Multi-level aggregate order book update (MBP) — depth-of-book levels 1-10 per side.

field.name: sequenceId
field.description: Global sequence ID

field.name: sourceTimestamp
field.description: Source timestamp (nanos since epoch). CME: TransactTime.

field.name: ingestTimestamp
field.description: Ingest timestamp

field.name: symbol
field.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol

field.name: sourceSymbol
field.description: Exact symbol as received from data source. CME: tag 55 verbatim.

field.name: source
field.description: Data source

field.name: sourceSecurityId
field.description: Source security ID. CME: SecurityID.

field.name: assetClass
field.description: Asset class

field.name: updateType
field.description: SNAPSHOT (full book) or DELTA (incremental level updates)

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument seq num. CME: RptSeq.

field.name: price
field.description: Price at this book level. CME: MDEntryPx.

field.name: size
field.description: Aggregate quantity at this level. CME: MDEntrySize.

field.name: numberOfOrders
field.description: Number of orders at this level. CME: NumberOfOrders.

field.name: priceLevel
field.description: Book level: 1=best, 2=second best, ..., 10=deepest. CME: MDPriceLevel.

field.name: side
field.description: Side: 0=Bid, 1=Ask, 2=ImpliedBid, 3=ImpliedAsk. CME: MDEntryTypeBook.

field.name: action
field.description: Update action: 0=New, 1=Change, 2=Delete, 3=DeleteThru, 4=DeleteFrom, 5=Overlay. CME: MDUpdateAction.

field.name: tradeableSize
field.description: Tradeable qty at this level. CME: TradeableSize (sinceVersion 10).

sbe:message.name: MatchEventBoundary
sbe:message.description: End-of-event marker for atomic event processing. Emitted after all messages from a single matching engine event are published.

field.name: sourceTimestamp
field.description: Source timestamp of the event. CME: TransactTime.

field.name: eventFlags
field.description: Event content flags: bit0=trades, bit1=volume, bit2=quotes, bit3=statistics, bit4=implied, bit5=recovery

field.name: messageCount
field.description: Number of MarketDataTick/BookUpdate/OrderUpdate/TradeSummary messages in this event

field.name: firstSequenceId
field.description: Sequence ID of the first message in this event batch
